newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOY SHIPPING CONDITIONS AT KEY BRAZILIAN PORTS.
newsitem.headline: SOY SHIPPING CONDITIONS AT KEY BRAZILIAN PORTS.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

PARANAGUA: Vessels: Histria Star loading 50,400 tonnes soybeans. Nadelhorn loading 25,612 tonnes soymeal. Peljesac loading 55,000 tonnes soymeal. Kriti Seloxenia loading 20,524 tonnes mixed cargo soyoil/cornoil. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load soymeal, five to load soybeans and two for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal). Road: 457 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on Aug 7, as well as 259 trucks with soymeal and 89 trucks with vegetable oils, including soyoil. Loading (Aug 7): 28,015 tonnes soybeans, 24,396 tonnes soymeal. Stocks: no figures available. NOTE: Loading resumed Thursday after rain hampered operations for most of the week. On Friday, skies were partly cloudy and the weather was cool and windy but dry.

SANTOS: Vessels: no data available. Road: 91 trucks carrying 2,563 tonnes soybeans arrived on Aug 7 as well as nine trucks with 241 tonnes soymeal. Rail: none. Loading (Aug 7): 5,602 tonnes soybeans. Stocks: 27,936 tonnes soybeans, 12,210 tonnes soymeal.
